title: Release The Bull
style: 112 BPM upbeat coaching anthem, female lead vocal warm and smiling, acoustic guitar strumming, light kit drums, hand claps, gang vocal chorus, sunny pickleball energy, motivational, friendly
lyrics:
[Intro - acoustic guitar, hand claps, female warm voice]
(spoken, smiling)
okay, kitchen line, listen up.
you've been holding the bull all morning.
good news. it's time.
release the bull.

[Verse 1 - female lead, warm, half-sung]
you've been dinking soft, you've been dinking smart
you've been waiting for the moment with a patient heart
the ball came up just a little too high
and the coach just nodded, you don't need to ask why

you shifted your weight, you turned your hip
you let the paddle face do its little flip
and the bull that you were holding all morning long
finally got to run where the bull belongs

[Pre-Chorus - claps build, kit enters]
release the bull, release the bull
you've earned the swing, the moment is full
release the bull, release the bull
you waited patient, now make it pull

[Chorus - gang vocal, sunny]
release the bull on the high ball
release the bull when the moment calls
release the bull, release the bull
the kitchen line earned this fall
release the bull on the high ball
release the bull when the moment calls
release the bull, release the bull
that's how the kitchen line wins it all

[Verse 2 - female, slightly fuller]
the other side wasn't ready for the speed
because they thought the kitchen line would always concede
but the kitchen line is patient, the kitchen line is kind
until the kitchen line decides it's time to find

the gap between their feet and the line in the back
the gap between their paddle and the angle they lack
and the bull goes through it like a yellow streak
and the point is over before they speak

[Pre-Chorus]
release the bull, release the bull
you've earned the swing, the moment is full
release the bull, release the bull
you waited patient, now make it pull

[Chorus]
release the bull on the high ball
release the bull when the moment calls
release the bull, release the bull
the kitchen line earned this fall
release the bull on the high ball
release the bull when the moment calls
release the bull, release the bull
that's how the kitchen line wins it all

[Bridge - acoustic alone, female warm spoken]
holding the bull is the harder part.
ten dinks, twenty dinks, thirty dinks, smart.
then one ball comes up just a little too high.
and you don't have to think. you just have to fly.
that's the gift the patient game gives you.
that's the moment the kitchen line lives through.

[Final Chorus - biggest, gang vocal full, claps loud]
release the bull on the high ball
release the bull when the moment calls
release the bull, release the bull
the kitchen line earned this fall
release the bull on the high ball
release the bull when the moment calls
release the bull, release the bull
that's how the kitchen line wins it all
release the bull
release the bull

[Outro - acoustic strum, claps fade, female smile]
good swing.
good patience.
same thing tomorrow.
release the bull.
